name: Safe Input Buffer
description: Delays a click by a few frames if clicking right now would kill you.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Turn the input buffer on or off.

only-near-hazards.name: Only Check Near Hazards
only-near-hazards.description: Only runs the death check when a spike or saw is close. Much less lag, but won't catch solid-block deaths.

max-delay-frames.name: Max Delay (frames)
max-delay-frames.description: How many frames a click can be held back while waiting for a safe moment. After this, the click fires normally.

lookahead-ticks.name: Lookahead (ticks)
lookahead-ticks.description: How far ahead (in 1/240s physics ticks) the death check simulates. Lower is lighter, higher is more accurate.
